reviews.title: Best timer app
reviews.text: Puts the native clock app to shame. The new update with showing what actual time of day the timers end for each interval is beyond helpful. The developer is super open to feedback and they actually implement it! Makes you feel you had a part in its development which makes me loyal to the app. Keep it up!

reviews.title: Gotten rid of time lapse
reviews.text: I don’t know why you would get rid of the time lapse feature so we know just looking how much time has gone while the timer has been going. I would like to know if I have spent 40min on something without taking a minute to calculate it in my head. It been useful for a while and I paid for the full package but this is not an update I like.

reviews.title: Useful for pumping tracking and recording
reviews.text: I have an iPhone and need to track my pumping sessions and have a timer to help me know when to stop. I can adjust the volume and allow notifications if I’m in another app which is super convenience since I loose track of time easily in the middle of the night when I’m the most tired. Wish it stored more data regarding the times I started and stopped past 3 session.

reviews.title: Best timer Ever
reviews.text: I have to say that I didn’t think I would use this timer for much but I was wrong I use it daily and I have 5 different timers that I use since I can label them specifically for whatever I am doing from diamond paintings to paint projects or just coloring in general or whatever else I want to do it counts up or down makes a lap timer when I’m walking it’s extremely simple and easy to use I would recommend it for any one especially if you are a regular diamond painter as I am .

reviews.title: Excellent App
reviews.text: Been using it for several years - on our iPad & Apple Phone. Where you can use it - it is really up to your imagination. 1) I use it as an alarm for when to start a task 2) I use it when cooking multiple items in a meal. 3) I use the multiple feature to remind when to stir, flip, etc. Easy to use!

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text:
So when it works, it’s not bad but…
Unlike other similar apps, there is no way to luck it and so I start it, put it in my pocket and than the app get deleted…
And the worst is that they do have history that keeps all past programs but there is no way to reinstate it. After 3 occasions where I had to stop in the middle of my workout and rebuild my workout, I gave up.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: I get this timer app so I could set repeatable alerts to take medication for the next couple of days. Missing a dose means periods of extreme pain. I just woke up in agony after missing a dose to a silent notification box that a timer had gone off with no indication of a sound ever being played. I tried setting one up as a test and it seems that this timer app can’t do timers. If you need an app to file you lock screen with useless banners this $20 purchase is for you, otherwise, stay away.

reviews.title: Audio ducking problems
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for a few years and every so often there is an issue with audio ducking. It seems that certain ads have an effect on the audio volume when alarms go off, many times, lately, the volume does not return to its original level, requiring the app to be closed and reopened. The more annoying issue is when the music just STOPS - the music has to be manually restarted from the source app.  This has gotten to be such an issue, so frequently, that it’s sent me on a search for a replacement as the subscription cost for ad removal is absurd.

It’s happening again. It seems certain ads just stop the music from playing

reviews.title: Excellent app, wonderful developers
reviews.text: The stopwatch function has been incredibly useful for me in timing my medications. As far as I can tell, there’s no other app like it. The recent addition of timer history has been very useful. I’ve contacted the developers with suggestions for features and they’ve been incredibly responsive. Absolutely been worth the price, it’s an essential for me at this point. The only feature I can think of that I might like to add is a search bar for my timers (I have 100+ and it can be difficult to find them) or maybe a way to create folders or categories for them… Also perhaps a way to lock timers so I don’t accidentally hit the [X] button and end them. Either way, thank you for all your hard work.
